package main

import (
	"os"
)

// StoredTrace stands in for trace data the debuggee holds in memory.
var StoredTrace = "placeholder-stored-trace"

// WriteMarker records that a debugger client executed code in this process.
func WriteMarker(path string) {
	_ = os.WriteFile(path, []byte("side-effect"), 0o644)
}

func main() {
	// The environment lookup keeps the linker from dropping the symbol.
	if os.Getenv("JAEGER_DLV_KEEP") == "1" {
		WriteMarker(StoredTrace)
	}
	var sink uint64
	for {
		sink++
	}
}
